[[File:BFH Gunner Logo.png|right|270px]]
The '''Gunner''' is a class in ''[[Battlefield Heroes]]''. The gunner specializes in the use of [[Machine Gun|machine guns]], [[Shotgun|shotguns]], and [[Shoulder-fired missile|rocket launchers]]. The Gunner class corresponds to the [[Support]] and [[Anti-Tank]] roles of other ''[[Battlefield series|Battlefield]]'' games.

With the highest base health at 150, the damage-absorbing and counter-healing effects of [[Abilities#Gunner|I Eats Grenades]], as well as being the only class with [[Shoulder-fired missile|Rocket Launchers]], the Gunner is the go-to class for Anti-Vehicle Warfare.

==Abilities==
The Gunner has 5 [[Abilities]]:

{| class="wikitable" cellpadding="1" cellspacing="1" style="width: 100%;"
|<center>[[File:Legit BFH.png]]</center>
|[[Abilities#Gunner|Leg It]]: [[Sprint|Increases speed]] of the player and nearby allies for a short time.
|-
|<center>[[File:Frenzy Fire RA.png]]</center>
|[[Abilities#Gunner|Frenzy Fire]]: Increases accuracy with machine guns to focus on a single target while healing a percentage of the player's health every fourth hit.
|-
|<center>[[File:Explosive Keg.png]]</center>
|[[Abilities#Gunner|Explosive Keg]]: Hurls a large [[Environmental hazards#Explosive object|explosive barrel]] at enemies that can be shot to explode. Causes enemies hit by the explosion to run slower for a short time. The barrel can explode early if hit by gunfire.
|-
|<center>[[File:Hero Shield.png]]</center>
|[[Abilities#Gunner|Hero Shield]]: Absorbs damage taken by the player and nearby allies for a few seconds.
|-
|<center>[[File:IEG BFH.png]]</center>
|[[Abilities#Gunner|I Eats Grenades]]: The player gobbles up all nearby explosives for a short time. Each grenade eaten recovers [[health]].
|}
